title: Molecular Gas Mass Measurements of an Active, Starburst Galaxy at z ≍ 2.6 Using ALMA Observations of the [C I], CO, and Dust Emission
question: What are the molecular gas mass and ISM excitation conditions of a z=2.57 radio-loud starburst galaxy, as inferred from [CI], CO and dust emission?

data.sensitivity: Continuum RMS 10 (Band 4) and 11 (Band 6); line RMS ≈0.25 and ≈0.17 mJy per channel

what.value: Dust temperature 45 (+23/-17) K and SED fit from Falkendal2019; dust flux 1.33±0.16 mJy

evidence.quote: dust temperature of $\Td=45^{+23}_{-17}\,$K derived from the SED fitting
we adopted the value commonly used for starburst galaxies, 0.8 M$_\odot$/(K$\cdot$km s$^{-1}$$\cdot$pc$^2$) (cite: Bolatto2013)
we adapted the atomic carbon abundance $\,=\,3\times10^{-5}$ as derived by (cite: Weiss2003) for M82
Here we use $\alphadust=6.7\cdot10^{19}$ erg s$^{-1}$ Hz$^{-1}$ M$_\odot$$^{-1}$ and equation (16) in (cite: Scoville2016)

what.value: Comparison compilation of high-z line ratios

evidence.quote: the compilation of high-redshift galaxies presented in (cite: Valentino2020)

recipe.method: tclean with Briggs robust=2, line-free continuum, binned cubes
2D Gaussian fits with imfit to each component
Elliptical aperture spectrum; Gaussian lines plus first-order polynomial continuum; 1000 Monte Carlo realizations
spectral-cube moment over ±2σ of Gaussian; size from 3σ contour

recipe.goal: Derive molecular gas mass three ways
recipe.method: [CI] with LTE Tex, CO(4-3) with r41 and alpha_CO, Band 6 dust with Scoville2016
assumptions: X_CI=3e-5, r41=0.46, alpha_CO=0.8, Td=25 K, alpha_dust=6.7e19, helium factor 1.36

not_stated_but_needed: Spatial extent and orientation of the elliptical extraction aperture
Exact velocity ranges / channels used in spectral fits and moment maps
tclean cell size, image size, masks, threshold, niter
Dust SED/Gamma_RJ value for Td=25 K
missing_for_reproduction: Gamma_RJ value and luminosity distance details
score_reason: Standard CASA workflow and explicit formulas, but aperture and imaging parameters not given.
rediscovery_reason: Archive data with explicit formulas and numeric results, though some imaging settings missing.
